method: Fresh browser context per version. Primary metric: actual HTTP response body bytes measured in preview-server middleware, including all worker and Range requests; content lengths cross-checked. Window timing and worker measures are retained as partial corroboration only (legacy raw-GLB worker values can be missing). Local 1600x1000, not an internet bandwidth promise. HEAD response body bytes are zero and are excluded; bytesPassedToEnd records buffers offered to Node on HEAD only, not transmitted data.
